flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/{AmountPayableCalculationService,ChangeOfProcessingService,EligibilityService}, crud/ocmsizdb/parameter (ParameterController), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice (surcharge column), crud/beans/SystemConstant. ocmsadminprivateapi utilities/suspension_helpers/RevivalBaseHelper, framework/workflows/autorevival/helpers/AutoRevivalHelper, framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper. ocmsadminui pages/System (ParameterList, ParameterForm), App.tsx. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: The story asks that the surcharge amount per stage can be set by an officer (example +$X at final reminder, +$Y at court processing). The surcharge is stored in ocms_parameter (parameter_id SUR, code = stage) and can be edited on System > Parameter; AmountPayableCalculationService adds it to composition_amount when the stage changes to CPC/CSD/CSR/COS/COM and the portal CPS stores it in column VON.surcharge (ticket OCMS-SR-2026-107, Closed). Important notes. (1) The story's 'final reminder' example is not charged as a surcharge: at RR3/DR3 the code adds an administration fee from parameter ADM; a SUR/RR3 row would never be read. (2) CFC is deliberately excluded from the surcharge in adminapi, but the revival path in ocmsadminprivateapi still adds SUR for CFC, so the two layers are inconsistent (depends on whether a SUR/CFC row exists; cannot verify from repo). (3) From the portal CPS only CPC can be chosen as a court stage (EligibilityService.java:49-50); how a notice enters CSD/CSR/COS/COM was not found in the repo. (4) The PLUS path adds the surcharge to amount_payable but does not write the surcharge column. (5) The value is not validated as a number; a wrong value makes the surcharge ignored with an error log. Real SUR/ADM values on the server: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Can be claimed for the per-stage SUR configuration and the calculation at court stage CPC through the portal CPS. The 'final reminder' part is handled as an administration fee (ADM), not a surcharge; ask URA/the team to confirm that is accepted, and align the CFC treatment between adminapi and revival

steps.step: The surcharge of each stage is stored as parameter SUR and the officer can change it on the Parameter page
steps.detail: The System > Parameter page (App.tsx:375-396) lists all ocms_parameter rows (POST /parameterlist, ParameterController.java:81-88) and allows editing the description and value fields through POST /parameterpatch/{id1}/{id2} (ParameterController.java:90-118; form ParameterForm.tsx:154-175). The SUR row (Parameter ID SUR, Code = stage) is read through getSurchargeForStage (AmountPayableCalculationService.java:40-41, 258-263). Function OCMS_SYSTEM_PARAMETER is mapped in api-authorization.properties:166-167; which roles hold it: cannot verify from repo. Note: the value is only required, with no number or range check (ValidParameter.ts:44-46); a non-numeric value makes getParameterAmount return null and the surcharge is ignored with an error log. No seed of the initial values was found in the repo.

steps.step: When a notice is moved to a court stage, the amount payable is increased by the configured surcharge
steps.detail: calculateAmountPayable adds SUR/<stage> to composition_amount for the new stages CPC, CSD, CSR, COS, COM (AmountPayableCalculationService.java:105-107, 121-124, 194-209; the COURT_STAGES_SURCHARGE set at SystemConstant.java:105-107). CFC is deliberately excluded (OCMS-SR-2026-107, Closed, Prod deployed). The portal CPS calls it when the stage changes (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1006-1008). From the portal only CPC can be chosen as a court stage (EligibilityService.java:49-50); how a notice enters CSD/CSR/COS/COM was not found in the repo. If the SUR row is missing or badly formatted, amount_payable is only the composition amount (error log, no message to the officer). Real values: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The applied surcharge amount is also stored on the notice (surcharge column)
steps.detail: The portal CPS writes von.setSurcharge(...) for stages CPC/CSD/CSR/COS/COM (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1016-1030; column in OcmsValidOffenceNotice.java:210-213). The PLUS path (processPlusChangeStage) computes amount_payable with the same surcharge but does not write the surcharge column (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1484-1498; setSurcharge only exists at line 1022), so amount and column can disagree for stage changes through PLUS. Whether ticket OCMS-SR-2026-107 covers PLUS: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The extra charge at the final reminder stage can be set separately from the court stage
steps.detail: At RR3 (hirer) and DR3 (driver) the code adds an administration fee from parameter ADM/<stage> to composition_amount (AmountPayableCalculationService.java:40, 101-103, 112-119, 182-192) and writes administration_fee (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1157-1167; ToppanUploadHelper.java:1834, 2070). This is equivalent to an 'extra charge at final reminder' and can be edited on the same Parameter page, but it is named administration fee, not surcharge, and a SUR/RR3 row is never read (SUR is only for CPC and other court stages). The bug in ticket OCMS-DF-2026-170 ($15 fee stored on notices not at RR3/DR3) is closed and Prod deployed. Real ADM values: cannot verify from repo; whether URA accepts 'administration fee at RR3/DR3' as 'surcharge at final reminder' needs confirmation.

steps.step: The automatic paths (revival and cron) use the same configured surcharge consistently
steps.detail: TS-RED revival reads SUR/<stage> for CPC, CFC, CSD, CSR, COS, COM (RevivalBaseHelper.java:570-576; AutoRevivalHelper.java:350-354, 479-483), so the value edited on the Parameter page is used. But the stage set differs from adminapi, which excludes CFC (SystemConstant.java:105-107); if a SUR/CFC row exists, revival adds it while CPS does not. The Toppan cron does not write the surcharge when a stage advances; it only puts the SUR/CPC value into the letter data for every stage (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2084), regardless of the stage. A job in the repo that moves a notice to CPC and then adds the surcharge was not found. Whether a SUR/CFC row exists on the server: cannot verify from repo.
